reason: The hypothesis directly combines the known surface laser remelting technique (P28) with the layer-by-layer remelting strategy already used in SLM of refractory HEAs (P34) and the thermal management concept from DED (P25), but it does not integrate these into a new mechanism or resolve a conflict; it merely proposes applying a known combination to a common HEA system (CoCrFeNiMn) with predictable outcomes.
